name: residual-focused-211
launchCondition: Wait for all comparison-head 96/192 evaluations. If none exceeds parent development team point estimate, run this curriculum comparison; otherwise reassess.
hypothesis: Live audit of comparison training: about 61% model decisions are self-play and about 15% whole-team versus v1.5. Test greater exposure to the benchmark opponent while retaining self-play/mixed historical teammates; do not assume this causes the plateau.
initialization: Same parent weights and architecture without comparison head; fresh identical Adam/RNG. Only schedule mixture differs. No changed reward or observation.

development.report: All four checkpoints and paired between-arm endpoint difference; seven lineups and hero/mixed controls. Reused development only.

decision: Report both arms at both checkpoints and mixed controls; no changing schedule after seeing partial results, no automatic promotion/deployment. Retain previous best and unused final seeds.
